d: Grand Theft Auto VI is out today, and it’s basically a foregone conclusion that it’s going to be an enormous hit. (It’s also just a spectacularly great game.) But what does this one title mean for the rest of the gaming industry? Game File’s Stephen Totilo explains how GTA became so important to the gaming business, why GTA Online might be an even bigger deal, and why we might never see another game quite like this one.
